what.zh: SGLang 默认开启 RadixAttention 前缀缓存；选择关会传 --disable-radix-cache。
what.en: SGLang keeps its RadixAttention prefix cache on by default; Off passes --disable-radix-cache.

what.zh: 开启后按张量并行卡数传 --ep-size，让专家分布在同一组 GPU 上。
what.en: When on, --ep-size is passed with the tensor-parallel GPU count so the experts spread over the same GPUs.

what.zh: SGLang 设置了工具调用解析器就会自动选择工具；关闭时不传解析器。
what.en: SGLang chooses tools automatically whenever a tool-call parser is set; Off leaves the parser out.

message.zh: 这个模型的权重里没有 MTP 层，不能使用 MTP 推测解码；请关闭推测解码或换用其他方式。
message.en: This checkpoint has no MTP layers, so MTP speculative decoding cannot start; turn speculative decoding off or pick another method.

what.zh: SGLang 目前只能通过启动参数接收密钥；平台会在命令、日志和界面中把它替换为 <redacted>。
what.en: SGLang only takes the key as a launch flag today; the platform replaces it with <redacted> in commands, logs and the console.

label.zh: 静态显存比例（启动时空闲显存）
label.en: Static memory fraction (of free VRAM at start)

summary.zh: SGLang 按启动时空闲显存的这个比例分配权重和 KV 池。
summary.en: SGLang sizes the weights plus the KV pool as this fraction of the memory free when it starts.

what.zh: 对应 --mem-fraction-static。它是空闲显存的比例，不是整卡比例：桌面或其它模型已经占用的显存不算在内。
what.en: Maps to --mem-fraction-static. It is a fraction of free memory, not of the whole GPU: memory the desktop or other models already use is not counted.

whenToChange.zh: 启动时报显存不足就调小；需要更大的 KV 池时调大。
whenToChange.en: Lower it when the start runs out of memory; raise it for a bigger KV pool.

tradeoffs.zh: 过高会让 CUDA Graph 和激活没有余量而崩溃；配合 KV 池容量上限可以让显存准入的预算可预测。
tradeoffs.en: Too high leaves no room for CUDA graphs and activations and can crash; pairing it with a KV pool size limit keeps the admission budget predictable.

summary.zh: SGLang 共享 KV 池最多容纳的 token 数，所有并发请求共用。
summary.en: Maximum tokens in SGLang's shared KV pool; all concurrent requests share it.

what.zh: 对应 --max-total-tokens。不设置时，SGLang 用静态显存比例在权重之外剩下的全部空间。
what.en: Maps to --max-total-tokens. Unset, SGLang fills whatever the static memory fraction leaves after the weights.

whenToChange.zh: 需要限制显存占用，或让显存准入的预算可预测时。
whenToChange.en: To bound memory use and make the admission budget predictable.

tradeoffs.zh: 越小越省显存，但长上下文的并发请求会排队。
tradeoffs.en: Smaller saves memory; long concurrent requests queue.

summary.zh: KV 缓存按多少个 token 为一页来分配。
summary.en: How many tokens make up one KV cache page.

what.zh: 对应 --page-size。部分注意力后端和混合架构要求特定的页大小。
what.en: Maps to --page-size. Some attention backends and hybrid architectures need a specific page size.

whenToChange.zh: 按已验证方案或注意力后端的要求设置。
whenToChange.en: Set it as a validated recipe or the attention backend requires.

tradeoffs.zh: 页越大，前缀复用的粒度越粗，未填满的页浪费越多。
tradeoffs.en: Bigger pages reuse prefixes more coarsely and waste more on partly filled pages.

summary.zh: 长提示词按这么多 token 一块分批预填充。
summary.en: Long prompts are prefilled in chunks of this many tokens.

what.zh: 对应 --chunked-prefill-size，平台默认 8192。
what.en: Maps to --chunked-prefill-size; the platform default is 8192.

whenToChange.zh: 预填充长提示词时显存峰值过高就调小。
whenToChange.en: Lower it when prefilling long prompts peaks too high in memory.

tradeoffs.zh: 越小越省激活显存，但长提示词开始回答得更慢。
tradeoffs.en: Smaller chunks save activation memory but make long prompts slower to start answering.

summary.zh: 直接设定 SGLang 的运行请求上限，优先于“最大并发请求”；已验证方案通常按缓存容量推导它。
summary.en: Sets SGLang's running-request cap directly and wins over Max concurrent requests; validated recipes usually derive it from cache capacity.

what.zh: 设置后用它代替最大并发请求作为 --max-running-requests。
what.en: When set, it replaces Max concurrent requests as --max-running-requests.

whenToChange.zh: 混合架构的状态缓存只够少数请求同时运行时。
whenToChange.en: When a hybrid architecture's state cache only fits a few requests at once.

tradeoffs.zh: 低于最大并发请求时，多出来的请求会排队。
tradeoffs.en: Below Max concurrent requests, the extra requests wait in the queue.

summary.zh: SGLang 注意力计算使用的实现。
summary.en: The implementation SGLang uses for attention.

what.zh: 对应 --attention-backend。不设置时按模型档或引擎默认选择。
what.en: Maps to --attention-backend. Unset, the model profile or the engine default decides.

whenToChange.zh: 当前显卡不支持默认后端，或已验证方案指定了后端时。
whenToChange.en: When this GPU does not support the default backend, or a validated recipe names one.

tradeoffs.zh: 不同后端的速度和稳定性不同，选错可能启动失败或输出异常。
tradeoffs.en: Backends differ in speed and stability; a wrong one may fail to start or misbehave.

summary.zh: NVFP4 权重矩阵乘法使用的实现。
summary.en: The implementation used for NVFP4 weight matrix multiplication.

what.zh: 对应 --fp4-gemm-backend，只对 FP4 量化的模型有意义。
what.en: Maps to --fp4-gemm-backend; it only matters for FP4-quantized models.

whenToChange.zh: NVFP4 模型输出异常或速度不理想时，按已验证方案选择。
whenToChange.en: When an NVFP4 model gives bad output or runs slowly, pick the backend a validated recipe names.

tradeoffs.zh: 部分后端只支持特定显卡架构。
tradeoffs.en: Some backends only support specific GPU architectures.

summary.zh: 把逐层嵌入（PLE）表放到系统内存，给 KV 缓存腾出显存。
summary.en: Keeps per-layer embedding (PLE) tables in system RAM to free GPU memory for the KV cache.

what.zh: 对应 --ple-offload-embedding，需要运行时支持 PLE 卸载。
what.en: Maps to --ple-offload-embedding and needs a runtime that supports PLE offload.

whenToChange.zh: 带 PLE 的模型显存紧张、又需要长上下文时。
whenToChange.en: When a model with PLE tables is short on memory and needs long context.

tradeoffs.zh: 占用系统内存，嵌入查找会稍慢。
tradeoffs.en: Uses system RAM, and embedding lookups get slightly slower.

label.zh: 线性注意力预填充后端

summary.zh: 混合线性注意力模型在预填充阶段使用的实现。
summary.en: The implementation hybrid linear-attention models use while prefilling.

what.zh: 对应 --linear-attn-prefill-backend，需要运行时支持。
what.en: Maps to --linear-attn-prefill-backend and needs runtime support.

whenToChange.zh: 按已验证方案设置，或默认后端在当前显卡上出错时。
whenToChange.en: Set it as a validated recipe says, or when the default fails on this GPU.

tradeoffs.zh: 不同后端的速度和稳定性不同。
tradeoffs.en: Backends differ in speed and stability.

summary.zh: 混合线性注意力模型在逐 token 生成阶段使用的实现。
summary.en: The implementation hybrid linear-attention models use while generating tokens.

what.zh: 对应 --linear-attn-decode-backend，需要运行时支持。
what.en: Maps to --linear-attn-decode-backend and needs runtime support.

whenToChange.zh: 按已验证方案设置，或默认后端在当前显卡上出错时。
whenToChange.en: Set it as a validated recipe says, or when the default fails on this GPU.

tradeoffs.zh: 不同后端的速度和稳定性不同。
tradeoffs.en: Backends differ in speed and stability.

summary.zh: 混合 Mamba/线性注意力模型保存递归状态的精度。
summary.en: The precision hybrid Mamba or linear-attention models keep their recurrent state in.

what.zh: 对应 --mamba-ssm-dtype，需要运行时支持 Mamba 控制项。
what.en: Maps to --mamba-ssm-dtype and needs a runtime with Mamba controls.

whenToChange.zh: 按已验证方案设置；输出异常时可以试更高精度。
whenToChange.en: Set it as a validated recipe says; try a higher precision when output looks wrong.

tradeoffs.zh: 精度越高状态缓存越占显存。
tradeoffs.en: Higher precision makes the state cache use more memory.

summary.zh: 混合模型的状态缓存如何配合前缀缓存使用。
summary.en: How a hybrid model's state cache works with the prefix cache.

what.zh: 对应 --mamba-radix-cache-strategy，需要运行时支持 Mamba 控制项。
what.en: Maps to --mamba-radix-cache-strategy and needs a runtime with Mamba controls.

whenToChange.zh: 按已验证方案设置。
whenToChange.en: Set it as a validated recipe says.

tradeoffs.zh: 额外缓冲能提高前缀复用率，但会占用更多显存。
tradeoffs.en: Extra buffers improve prefix reuse but use more memory.

summary.zh: 每隔多少个 token 保存一次可复用的状态快照。
summary.en: How many tokens pass between reusable state snapshots.

what.zh: 对应 --mamba-track-interval，需要运行时支持 Mamba 控制项。
what.en: Maps to --mamba-track-interval and needs a runtime with Mamba controls.

whenToChange.zh: 按已验证方案设置。
whenToChange.en: Set it as a validated recipe says.

tradeoffs.zh: 间隔越小前缀复用越细，但快照占用更多显存。
tradeoffs.en: Shorter intervals reuse prefixes more finely, but snapshots use more memory.

summary.zh: 状态缓存最多保存的槽位数，限制了能同时运行的请求数。
summary.en: The most slots the state cache holds, which limits how many requests run at once.

what.zh: 对应 --max-mamba-cache-size，需要运行时支持 Mamba 控制项。
what.en: Maps to --max-mamba-cache-size and needs a runtime with Mamba controls.

whenToChange.zh: 按已验证方案设置；需要更多并发、显存又有余量时调大。
whenToChange.en: Set it as a validated recipe says; raise it for more concurrency when memory allows.

tradeoffs.zh: 槽位越多越占显存。
tradeoffs.en: More slots use more memory.

summary.zh: DSpark 草稿每块预测的 token 数。
summary.en: How many tokens each DSpark draft block predicts.

what.zh: 对应 --speculative-dspark-block-size，只在推测解码方式为 DSpark 时使用。
what.en: Maps to --speculative-dspark-block-size and is only used with DSpark speculative decoding.

whenToChange.zh: 一般保持已验证的 7；按草稿接受率微调。
whenToChange.en: Usually keep the validated 7; tune it by the draft acceptance rate.

tradeoffs.zh: 块越大，猜中时加速越多，猜错时浪费也越多。
tradeoffs.en: Bigger blocks gain more when accepted and waste more when rejected.

summary.zh: 草稿模型权重的量化方式；unquant 表示不量化。
summary.en: How the draft model's weights are quantized; unquant means not at all.

what.zh: 对应 --speculative-draft-model-quantization。
what.en: Maps to --speculative-draft-model-quantization.

whenToChange.zh: 草稿模型本身是量化权重，或已验证方案指定时。
whenToChange.en: When the draft model itself is quantized, or a validated recipe names a value.

tradeoffs.zh: 量化草稿更省显存，但接受率可能下降。
tradeoffs.en: A quantized draft saves memory but may be accepted less often.

summary.zh: 混合模型在调度器里如何分配状态缓存。
summary.en: How the scheduler hands out state cache for hybrid models.

what.zh: 对应 --mamba-scheduler-strategy。
what.en: Maps to --mamba-scheduler-strategy.

whenToChange.zh: 按已验证方案设置。
whenToChange.en: Set it as a validated recipe says.

tradeoffs.zh: 设置不当会降低并发或前缀复用率。
tradeoffs.en: A poor choice lowers concurrency or prefix reuse.

summary.zh: 预填充阶段不使用 CUDA Graph。
summary.en: Prefill runs without CUDA graphs.

what.zh: 对应 --disable-prefill-cuda-graph。
what.en: Maps to --disable-prefill-cuda-graph.

whenToChange.zh: 预填充阶段的 CUDA Graph 在当前显卡或模型上出错时。
whenToChange.en: When prefill CUDA graphs fail on this GPU or model.

tradeoffs.zh: 预填充稍慢，但启动时显存峰值更低。
tradeoffs.en: Prefill gets slightly slower, but the start-up memory peak is lower.

summary.zh: 图片等多模态特征在进程之间如何传递。
summary.en: How image and other multimodal features move between processes.

what.zh: 对应 --mm-feature-transport。cpu 经系统内存传递。
what.en: Maps to --mm-feature-transport. cpu passes them through system RAM.

whenToChange.zh: 在 Docker Desktop/WSL 下遇到 CUDA IPC 错误时选 cpu。
whenToChange.en: Choose cpu when CUDA IPC errors appear under Docker Desktop/WSL.

tradeoffs.zh: 经内存传递稍慢，但更兼容。
tradeoffs.en: Going through RAM is slightly slower but more compatible.

label.zh: 空闲时降低 CPU 占用

summary.zh: 没有请求时让调度循环休眠，降低空闲时的 CPU 占用。
summary.en: Lets the scheduler loop sleep while no requests arrive, which lowers idle CPU use.

what.zh: 对应 --sleep-on-idle，平台默认开启。
what.en: Maps to --sleep-on-idle; the platform turns it on by default.

whenToChange.zh: 极少需要修改；排查首个请求延迟时可以关闭对比。
whenToChange.en: Rarely needs changing; turn it off to compare when investigating first-request latency.

tradeoffs.zh: 空闲后的第一个请求可能略慢。
tradeoffs.en: The first request after an idle period may be slightly slower.

summary.zh: 输出 /metrics 指标；平台统计依赖它，始终开启。
summary.en: Exposes /metrics; platform statistics depend on it, so it is always on.

what.zh: 对应 --enable-metrics，由平台管理。
what.en: Maps to --enable-metrics and is managed by the platform.

whenToChange.zh: 不能修改。
whenToChange.en: It cannot be changed.

tradeoffs.zh: 开销可以忽略。
tradeoffs.en: The overhead is negligible.
